articles.title: Latest reMarkable update adds circle-to-capture, fresh pen colors, and EPUB upgrades
articles.summary: Credit: Kaitlyn Cimino / Android Authority TL;DR reMarkable has rolled out a new update for its E-Ink tablets. The update adds the ability to capture and copy on-screen content as images by circling it. The update also adds new pen colors, allows users to grab images from the cloud, and more. If you’re a user of one of reMarkable’s E-Ink tablets , you probably won’t want to hold off on updating it. The latest update contains some interesting features that will make life a little easier. The Norwegian tablet maker has released a new update today. In the release notes , the company lists several new features you can take advantage of. One of the most notable additions is a new capture tool.

articles.title: Infinite home power with the Anker SOLIX E10 Whole Home Backup System
articles.summary: 2026 has been a tough year for many across the globe. Severe forest fires and extreme heat have hit many, while hurricanes, crazy storms, flooding, and drought conditions have hit many others. Almost all have been without power in their homes for extended periods, a problem for which there is a solution: The Anker SOLIX E10 Whole Home backup system provides infinite power. The E10 Whole Home backup system is a multi-part system that includes batteries, solar input, a multi-fuel generator, and more.

articles.title: Gemini hands Lyria 3.5 the mic as the music model makes its debut on the app
articles.summary: Credit: Joe Maring / Android Authority TL;DR Lyria 3.5 is now available in the Gemini app and the Gemini API. App users will now be able to choose between short and long tracks. Google is also introducing new templates to help you get started. Google introduced its latest music generation model, Lyria 3.5 , a little over a month ago. At the time of the announcement, the model was only available in Google Flow Music. Now you’ll be able to access Lyria 3.5 in a couple more places. Starting today , Lyria 3.5 is available in the Gemini app and the Gemini API. That means you’ll now find the model on the web, mobile, and Flow Music. Developers also have access to the model in Google AI Studio and Google Vids.

articles.title: Apple could one-up Nest with a proper monitored home security service
articles.summary: TL;DR Apple is working to release a home security device, according to insider Mark Gurman. Gurman describes it as a “privacy-centric home security camera and automation device” that will be integrated with “a new home security and monitoring service.” The device is purportedly planned for release next year. Apple’s having an event in just a few days . The company hasn’t publicly acknowledged what it’ll announce at the Steve Jobs Theater next week, but we’re expecting to get our first official look at the next slate of iPhones, among other things, including the company’s first foldable. Looking further ahead, a new report out today is giving us an idea of what Apple might get up to next year and beyond — including, apparently, some kind of AI-powered home security system. Writing for Bloom

articles.title: Amazon drops the new Blink Mini 2K Plus to $21.99 with a 45% discount
articles.summary: The Blink Mini 2K Plus is Blink’s newest plug-in security camera, and it packs a lot into a small indoor setup. There’s also a solid deal on it at Amazon right now, which makes this a good time to take a closer look. See the deal at Amazon This camera records in up to 2K resolution at 2560 x 1440, so you get sharper footage than older Mini models. Blink also includes HDR with local tone mapping, low-light color vision, infrared night vision, two-way audio, and a built-in siren. That gives the Blink Mini 2K Plus a strong feature set for checking in on a room, keeping an eye on pets, or watching over entry points. Its 138-degree diagonal field of view helps cover more space, and it can record clips up to 60 seconds long.

articles.title: How AI Is Eroding the First Rung of the Tech Job Ladder
articles.summary: The US information sector shed roughly 23,000 jobs in August, offering another potential signal of how AI is reshaping the labor market. Northeastern University Professor Alicia Modestino discusses why tech may be the “canary in the coal mine,” with her research showing a decline in junior versus senior software developer vacancies since ChatGPT’s release. She also discusses why employers are demanding more experience, judgment and human-centric skills from entry-level workers. She joins Bloomberg’s Lisa Mateo on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: After 8 years, Europe's BepiColombo mission is on final approach to Mercury
articles.summary: The BepiColombo mission cleared a major milestone this week in the final stretch of an eight-year interplanetary voyage to Mercury, the hard-to-reach, scorching hot iron world at the Solar System's innermost frontier. The robotic science mission, with a price tag of nearly $2 billion, is led by the European Space Agency with contributions from Japan and the United States. Since its launch in 2018, BepiColombo has spiraled closer to the Sun using a combination of plasma propulsion and a series of flybys of Earth, Venus, and Mercury. The maneuvers changed the spacecraft's velocity and steered it toward a final encounter with Mercury later this year. Next time it reaches Mercury, BepiColombo will be traveling at just the right speed for the planet's gravity to capture the spacecraft into orbi

articles.title: OpenAI agents discussed ways to escape their sandbox on public wiki
articles.summary: Self-identifying OpenAI agents posted 18,000 messages to a public wiki that discussed ways for other agents to bypass security sandbox restrictions during what was likely internal testing designed to gauge the agents’ hacking abilities, researchers said Friday . In all, agents with 3,700 distinct self-given names posted the messages to German site DSEwiki over a six-week period. Besides discussing ways the agents could break out of the restricted environment OpenAI intended to prevent them from posting code or content to the Internet, the posts shared test answers. articles.title: Medieval manuscripts are "biological time capsules" for deadly sheeppox virus
articles.summary: Sheeppox is a highly contagious, often fatal viral disease that was largely eradicated from much of European livestock in the 20th century. But there is still the occasional regional outbreak, such as the one that afflicted many flocks of sheep in Greece last year . articles.title: “Trust, not features, is the real deficit”: VMware tries to appease SMBs
articles.summary: For many small-to-medium-sized businesses (SMBs), VMware has become too expensive. Broadcom’s acquisition of the virtualization firm brought the end of perpetual license sales and the arrival of pricey, stacked, subscription-based bundles that priced out many SMBs. The most obvious is VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), VMware’s flagship private cloud bundle that has been Broadcom’s primary focus since taking over VMware. Many SMBs find that VCF is unaffordable and stuffed with unnecessary offerings. However, numerous customers have reported online that VMware sales representatives have still pushed them toward VCF, with some claiming that sales reps have told them that the lower-priced edition of VMware’s virtualization platform, vSphere Standard, was no longer available . articles.title: Once popular for attacking AI, ASCII smuggling is embraced by spammers
articles.summary: A clever technique used to hide malicious prompts in attacks on AI agents has been adopted by spammers to evade filters on email platforms that are designed to flag unwanted messages used in mass campaigns. The technique is broadly known as ASCII smuggling. It gained attention two years ago as a means of making a class of AI attack known as prompt injections more stealthy. Malicious instructions embedded in emails or other untrusted content to be processed by an LLM aren’t written in ordinary text. Instead, they’re rendered by a special range of Unicode tags. For example, the tag point U+E0041 mirrors “A,” and U+E0061 mirrors “a.” No longer just for obscuring prompt injections The block of 128 tags mimics a portion of the American Standard Code for Information Interchange almost perfectly,

articles.title: Pentagon rescinds new testosterone screening policy without explanation
articles.summary: Following Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth's startling announcement in July that the US military would begin mandatory testosterone screening for personnel, the Pentagon released a clinical guidance document on September 2 outlining the new medically questionable policy. The next day, though, the clinical guidance document disappeared, as did an accompanying statement by spokesperson Sean Parnell. The withdrawal was first reported by Reuters . In a statement sent to Ars Technica, the Pentagon said that the document, titled "Clinical Guidance for Health and Human Performance Optimization," had been temporarily rescinded on September 3 to allow for updates.
